title: Computer Network and Systems Technician
_note: Tasks from eMASCO (emasco.mohr.gov.my/masco/3513), fetched 21 Oct 2026. Questions are ours; each cites the task it was built from.

questions.text: Several users say the network is slow. How would you find the cause?
questions.source: eMASCO 3513, task 1: Mengendalikan, menyelenggara, dan mengesan masalah sistem rangkaian.

questions.text: Tell us about a time you helped someone with a connection problem. How did you explain the fix so they understood it?
questions.source: eMASCO 3513, task 3: Membantu pengguna dengan masalah rangkaian dan komunikasi data.

questions.text: Why do backups matter, and how would you check that a backup can really be restored?
questions.source: eMASCO 3513, task 6: Melaksanakan tugas menghidupkan dan mematikan sistem termasuk sistem sandaran dan operasi pemulihan bencana.
